RYIU Auto-Dividends Rewards

Auto-Dividend Feature

RYIU Token stands out with its cutting-edge feature that seamlessly provides rewards to its holders. There is an embedded mechanism that ensures a share of every transaction is automatically redirected to benefit current token owners.

Automated Tax Allocation Strategy

Each purchase or sale transaction is subject to a predetermined tax. The sophisticated RYIU Token smart contract is programmed to distribute half of these collected taxes amongst the current token holders (Auto-Dividends)

Perks for Holders

The perpetual reward system ingrained in the tokenomics offers a powerful motivation to retain the RYIU Token. As the project expands and thrives with ongoing transactions, holders gain effortless additional RYIU via regular dividend rewards.
